description: Use when the user wants to assess whether an AI agent repository (DataRobot-built or not) is enterprise-ready, run a gap analysis / readiness scan against security, governance, reliability, or regulatory standards, score an agent against EU AI Act requirements, or find and fix gaps (secrets, unpinned models, missing CI, missing guardrails, over-permissioned identity, etc.) before deploying an agent to production.
